purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for remote scopes, EXT bindings, remote authorization decisions and DWH data-release outcomes, linked to lineage evidence.

topics.name: DWH Policy Monitor
topics.purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for remote scopes, EXT bindings, remote authorization decisions and DWH data-release outcomes, linked to lineage evidence.

semantics.authority_rule: Viewing policy state grants no mutation/release authority.
semantics.redaction_rule: Restricted identities/data are redacted according to applicable policy.
semantics.trace_rule: Displayed decisions retain exact policy/evidence/lineage refs.
semantics.action_rule: Any configuration/remediation action invokes a separate authorized canonical editor/operation.
semantics.layout_rule: Visual grouping does not create policy relationships.

invariants.rule: DWH scope, release, remote access and policy decisions remain explicit, provenance-preserving and separate from transport reachability.

hard_gates.condition: visual grouping interpreted as policy relation

references.purpose: Monitor links release decisions to lineage.
